description: Archives (base64) a reader refuses with archive_invalid: the reason and the entry it names (null when no entry name was read). `caps` lowers the per-file and total caps; absent, they are 256 MiB and 1 GiB.

cases.name: root-file
cases.description: the root as a regular file

cases.name: path-too-long
cases.description: a pax path one byte over the 4096-byte cap

cases.name: path-too-long-utf8
cases.description: 4098 UTF-8 bytes in 2049 characters: the cap counts bytes

cases.name: duplicate-dot-slash
cases.description: ./a and a normalize to one path

cases.name: pax-malformed
cases.description: a pax record whose length is wrong

cases.name: trailing-garbage
cases.description: a non-zero byte after the end blocks

cases.name: truncated-data
cases.description: the stream ends inside a's data

cases.name: truncated-header
cases.description: the stream ends inside b's header

cases.name: file-cap
cases.description: a file over the lowered per-file cap

cases.name: total-cap
cases.description: b's data ends past the lowered total cap

cases.name: total-cap-end
cases.description: the end blocks pass the lowered total cap

cases.name: symlink-escape
cases.description: a symlink that leaves the root

cases.name: hardlink-missing
cases.description: a hardlink to a missing entry

cases.name: hardlink-later
cases.description: a hardlink to a later entry

cases.name: file-over-dir
cases.description: a file where an earlier entry made a directory
